method: Systematic full-text search and contextual verification of connection candidates; not a line-by-line reread
scope: Fires connection audit; comparison books are not independently fully audited
limitations: Not an exhaustive concordance or full illustration/annotation audit
Wind and Truth not fully downloaded or audited
Counterpart text not supplied for Warbreaker, Mistborn, Shadows for Silence or Rhythm of War
Text verification does not confirm an unspecified identity or theory

claims.title: The Prophet is Vasher
claims.locator: FanX 2026, September 25, entry 3; Fires XLI and Epilogue corroborate the character’s later activities.

claims.title: Breaths, passphrases and purified power
claims.locator: Fires XXVII (initial hypothesis); XXXVIII (Hoid’s explanation); Epilogue (passphrase changes).

claims.title: T’Telir’s Court of Gods
claims.locator: Fires IX, description of Kingseat’s fashion.

claims.title: A Nalthian audience?
claims.locator: Fires IX. Audience identification is not stated; the Court of Gods comparison alone does not identify the listeners.

claims.title: The Prophet’s dream and emissary
claims.locator: Fires XLI, December’s dream; Epilogue, the Prophet’s visit.

claims.title: Returned terminology, without a Returned cameo

claims.title: An Aon in a combined magical binding
claims.locator: Fires XXVI (rune); XXVII (named Aon); XXXVIII (buffer).

claims.title: Aon on the Ever-Slaying Sword
claims.locator: Fires XXVI, Tran Nguyen’s “Less a Sword, More a Spike” illustration. Painting inspected; Reo identification retained from Coppermind, not named in prose.

claims.title: Rivers and purified Dor: comparison
claims.locator: Fires XXXVIII describes purified power in the spike’s buffer. The river’s identity as Dor is not established.

claims.title: Hemalurgy-adjacent binding
claims.locator: Fires XXVI (Hemalurgic bind point); XXVII (“Hemalurgy-adjacent”); XXXVIII (silver and buffer).

claims.locator: Fires XXIV, December’s demonblood gown.

claims.title: Scadrial’s old canals
claims.locator: Fires III, the Northern Eclipse’s propulsion.

claims.title: A Soothing-like effect
claims.locator: Fires XXIV, bathing and emotional dampening.

claims.title: Threnodite entity lore
claims.locator: Fires IV, XXIV, XXVII and XLI; Threnody association from the cited reference. Emberdark XXV and XXXIX supply explicit related-entity terminology.

claims.title: Silver behaves differently across systems
claims.locator: Fires XXVI and XXXVIII; Shadows for Silence comparison via the cited silver reference.

claims.title: Shared entity family
claims.locator: Fires XXIV and XXVII; Emberdark XXV (Threnodite entity and Evil), XXXVI (Splinter of Ambition), XXXIX (Eidolith terminology).

claims.title: An explicit Ashyn reference
claims.locator: Fires XXVII, Hoid’s Godsflame remark; Epilogue, the trap in Valor’s temple.

claims.title: Another proposed memory incident
claims.locator: Fires XXVII; proposed Wind and Truth incident in external discussion.

claims.title: Roshar and the Prophet’s confinement
claims.locator: Fires XLI and Epilogue.

claims.title: Zuhel and Luhel
claims.locator: Fires XXVII (Zuhel named), XXXIV, XXXVII and XLII (bond behavior); Tress XXXI “The Midnight Essence” (Luhel and Nahel contrasted).

claims.title: The Dougs return
claims.locator: Fires VII; Tress XIV “The Dougs”.

claims.title: Herald terminology, without a Herald cameo
claims.locator: Fires XXVII, opening explanation.

claims.locator: Fires XXVII and XLII; Tress XXXI explicitly contrasts Nahel and Luhel. A universal three-Realm model is not established.
